original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚独立选举委员会拟用人工智能核查选举结果差异
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚独立选举委员会（INEC）官员表示，为迎接2027年大选，该委员会正部署人工智能以减少选举结果管理中的错误。该技术将核对电子录入数据与纸质结果表及扫描件是否一致，存在差异须先解决才能上传结果。专家警告该技术也可能被用于操纵选民、削弱公众对选举的信任。上述信息来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚独立选举委员会正部署人工智能以减少2027年大选结果管理中的错误
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Independent National Electoral Commission is deploying artificial intelligence to curb errors in election result management ahead of the 2027 general election

key_facts.fact: 该系统会核对电子录入数字与纸质结果表及扫描件是否一致，存在差异须先解决才能上传结果
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The system checks whether the figures entered electronically match those on the paper result sheets and scanned copies before transmission is allowed. If discrepancies exist, they must be resolved before the results can be uploaded.

key_facts.fact: 专家警告该技术也可能被用于操纵选民并削弱公众对选举的信任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: experts warn that the technology could also be exploited to manipulate voters and undermine public confidence in the electoral process

key_facts.fact: 相关消息在阿布贾举行的AI for Elections Programme and Hackathon启动仪式上披露
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This was disclosed on Thursday at the launch of the AI for Elections Programme and Hackathon organised by Rise Networks in Abuja

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
人工智能在选举中的实际部署效果与安全性尚未证实
专家关于技术被滥用的警告属风险提示，未获具体案例证实
